verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that ChatGPT can draft and refine documents, presentations, spreadsheets, and PDFs, and that users can review the result, ask for specific changes, and download the completed file. That covers creation, iterative editing, and export. Annotations let users point at a specific part of a file or slide preview and request a focused revision, and ChatGPT Work turns notes and research into decks and other finished work. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on community corroboration of document or presentation creation and export quality.
